title: 门店贡献利润与费用
context: 销售＋财务联合分析：管理层要求以同一企业口径核对业务数据。
requirements: 2025年线下每门店，净销售-销售成本-归属于门店的费用分录作为贡献利润（未扣人工与总部费用，非净利润）；保留所有门店，输出贡献率。
commonError: 费用不可按销售明细直接连接；贡献利润不是会计净利润。
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(net_cents) net,SUM(cost_cents) cost FROM v_sales_lines WHERE channel='store' AND order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY store_id), b AS (SELECT store_id,SUM(expense_cents) expense FROM v_expenses WHERE entry_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND store_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY store_id) SELECT s.store_id,COALESCE(a.net,0) net_cents,COALESCE(a.cost,0) cost_cents,COALESCE(b.expense,0) expense_cents,COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0) contribution_cents,ROUND(100.0*(COALESCE(a.net-a.cost,0)-COALESCE(b.expense,0))/NULLIF(a.net,0),2) contribution_pct FROM stores s LEFT JOIN a ON a.store_id=s.store_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.store_id=s.store_id ORDER BY contribution_cents DESC,s.store_id
